summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, attaching a press release announcing receipt of a first serial production order from a Singapore defense customer. The order follows a sample evaluation phase, with the customer transitioning to serial purchases. No financial terms, deal metrics, board actions, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine operational milestone and product order announcement; it does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
